transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1680 Kacee Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1680 Kacee Drive, just chillin’ here safe and sound, no water inside, and I’m all by myself but don’t need no help—no truck, no boat, no seats needed, just good as new.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here, all by myself, no one else around, and I’m totally fine—no water in the house either, so no rush.
Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just me, all good, no one here who can’t leave on their own, not even a wheelchair or oxygen—everything’s fine, no need for help.
Thanks for letting us know you're all set. Is there water inside the home right now?
Nope, no water inside at all, just me here, all good, no need for any help or trucks or boats—everything’s dry and I’m fine.
You’re all good, no water inside, and you’re fine. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Yeah, I’m good, no water in here at all, just me, and I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to give anyone a ride—sorry, not much I can do.
Thanks for letting us know your situation. Let me read that back: people at the home not confirmed; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me here, no water in yet, and I’m totally fine, no need for help or anything.
Thanks for confirming you’re okay and safe right now. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
